thread:
maya: quick note — ran a short-tail neighborhood consistency probe on the new v3-compact-int6 embeddings this morning :coffee:
rahul: nice, what metric did you use? recall@1/5 or something else?
maya: recall@1/5 + neighbor-flip rate across a 10k holdout. short-tail = queries < 8 tokens.
zoe: curious results?
maya: baseline float32 v2 had recall@1=0.82, recall@5=0.94. v3-compact-int6 shows recall@1=0.72, recall@5=0.90. neighbor-flip rate ~14% (was 4% on float32).
alejandra: whoa 14% is pretty high for short queries. did you run per-language breakdown?
maya: english only for this pass. I also checked cluster purity on kmeans(128) — purity dropped from 0.88 -> 0.80.
rahul: any chance this is due to quantization per-channel vs per-tensor? which quant scheme used?
maya: int6 per-tensor symmetric clamp, no bias compensation. I suspect dynamic range clipping for short queries kills some features.
zoe: can you paste the quick command you ran?
maya: sure:

```
python eval/neighborhood_probe.py \
  --model v3-compact-int6 \
  --holdout 10000 \
  --shorttail-maxlen 8 \
  --k 5 \
  --seed 42
```

maya: and the top-line output:
```
recall@1: 0.72
recall@5: 0.90
neigh_flip_rate: 0.14
cluster_purity_k128: 0.80
```

alejandra: can you repro on int8-perchannel? might be a sweet spot between size and locality.
maya: scheduled an int8-perchannel run now, will post numbers in ~30m.

sre-bot: job v3-compact-int8-pc-4920132468 started on runner-ml-06 (estimated 24m)

rahul: if int8 recovers recall@1 to >=0.80 we can try asymmetric quant + scale-clip. otherwise might need to revisit model distillation.
zoe: also check embedding norm distributions — short queries sometimes collapse norm after quant.
maya: good call, I dumped norms. float32 mean norm=12.1 sd=2.3, int6 mean=5.6 sd=1.4, int8-perchannel (running) will report.

alejandra: thanks. if int8-perchannel still bad, add a tiny calibration step (1000 short queries) to compute bias-correction and re-eval, that often helps.

maya: ack. will try calibration + asymmetric quant if int8 isn't enough. posting results when available :eyes:

sre-bot: job v3-compact-int8-pc-4920132468 finished (duration 23m)

maya: results from int8-perchannel: recall@1=0.79, recall@5=0.93, neigh_flip_rate=0.06, cluster_purity_k128=0.85
rahul: that's promising — recall@1 almost back to baseline and flip rate much improved.
zoe: can you run the small calibration (bias-correction) too and see if we hit >=0.81?
maya: queued calibration run, will update.

alejandra: once we confirm, recommend we set int8-perchannel as the default quant profile for short-tail workloads and keep int6 for long-tail (where cost matters more). also add an eval gate in onboarding that runs short-tail neighborhood probe.

maya: agreed — new onboarding checklist item: run short-tail locality probe + norm check + optional calibration. creating a ticket after this thread.
rahul: awesome, thanks maya :thumbsup:
